# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c28 P30](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and housekeeper  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Cuthbert  <sub>[v2 c1 P16](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0016), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with sharp angles and graying dark hair tied in a hard little knot held aggressively by two wire hairpins. Over time her figure grows somewhat thinner and more gaunt, though her facial expression softens noticeably with gentle eyes, a tender smile, and a mouth that hints at a sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla possesses a rigid conscience, a sensible disposition, and a practical, no-nonsense approach to life. Though outwardly strict, severe, and guarded against open displays of affection, she harbors a deep capacity for devotion, love, and quiet generosity. Over time, she mellows into a gentler and milder woman, though she retains a dry, sarcastic humor when provoked or after moments of self-betrayal.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041), [v1 c26 P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046), [v3 c7 P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 c7 P17](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0017), [v3 c22 P2](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0002)_

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived her entire life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew. In middle age, they decided to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, but a mistake resulted in the arrival of Anne Shirley. Though initially intent on rectifying the mistake, Marilla decided to keep Anne, resolving to raise her with proper discipline and moral training. Over the years, Marilla grew deeply attached to the imaginative girl, supporting her education up through Queen's Academy and college. Following Matthew's sudden death, Marilla faced the loss of Green Gables' main caretaker and began suffering from failing eyes and severe headaches. In later years, she took in her orphaned distant relatives, the Keith twins Davy and Dora, raising them alongside Rachel Lynde after Mrs. Lynde moved into Green Gables. Marilla saw Anne graduate, embark on her teaching career, and eventually marry Gilbert Blythe. In her later years, she traveled for the first time away from home to visit Anne at Four Winds for Christmas and returned in the spring to help attend to her after childbirth.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016), [v1 c36 P32](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0032), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v3 c22 P3](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0003), [v4 c2 P1](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0001), [v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 c19 P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 c19 P26](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Green Gables and was raised under strict childhood discipline rules  <sub>[v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031), [v2 c8 P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030)</sub>
- Hurt in childhood by an aunt calling her a dark, homely little thing  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- Quarreled with John Blythe in her youth out of wilful pride and refused to forgive him  <sub>[v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040), [v4 c2 P8](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0008)</sub>
- Never traveled more than sixty miles from home prior to visiting Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c15 P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001)</sub>
